name: Kiskunhalas (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of pale blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kiskunhalas (a crowned blue shield with a figure holding a sword, with white mantling) above the name KISKUNHALAS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kiskunhalas arms with crown and mantling
